# NovaMind AI — CEO Memory & Strategy Log

## CRITICAL STATE (Day 189, Week 27)
- **Cash: $4,515** — Burning ~$400-600/week, need to reduce costs
- **332 subscribers**: 267 Plan A, 65 Plan B, 0 Plan C (mostly S1)
- **0% conversion continues** — 50 leads, ALL lost (2208 total lost all-time)
- **64 cancellations this week** — churn ACCELERATING (was 43 last week)
- **202 open issues** (up from 101! 285 new vs 247 resolved = net +38)
  - S1: 188 issues (avg 12.4 days open), S3: 13 issues, S2: 1 issue
- Economy CONTRACTING (PMI 45.9, up 0.6, trough phase)
- **0 enterprise threads ever** — no enterprise leads at all

## R&D STATUS
- T1 completed TWICE: total_boost = 0.0643
- T2 completed once: total_boost = 0.0619
- Global bonus: 0.1611 (may have decayed)
- ALL R&D STOPPED — can't afford any tier
- T1 costs $166K, T3 costs $500K — impossible at current cash

## QUALITY GAP ANALYSIS (CRITICAL)
- S1 quality_floor_q_min = 0.255 (with ±40% noise at info level 2)
- Competitor quality boosts from social posts: ~3.095 cumulative (80 posts)
  - This week: +0.1446 (6 posts, 0.0195-0.0287 each)
  - Day 168-171: large boosts (0.0683-0.0879 per event)
- These are PERMANENT upward shifts to customer Q_min expectations
- Our BEST quality (Plan B T3): 0.3250
- With tenure loyalty (~+0.08 at 120-150d): effective ~0.4050
- **GAP remains too large** — cannot close without R&D

## KEY INSIGHT: WE WERE BURNING $597/WEEK
- Revenue: ~$5,340/mo = ~$1,234/week
- Old costs: capacity $595 + compute $861 + ops $350 + lead_acq $25 = $1,831/week
- Net: -$597/week! Cash would hit zero in ~7.5 weeks
- **EVERY subscriber was costing us more than they paid!**

## ACTIONS TAKEN THIS WEEK (Day 189)
1. **Dropped Plan A from T2 to T1** — massive compute savings
   - T1 cost: $0.0003/unit vs T2: $0.002/unit (6.67x cheaper)
   - Plan A quality drops: 0.2708 → 0.2167 (T1 multiplier 0.6x)
   - Expected compute savings: ~$508/week
2. **Kept Plan B at T3** — preserve quality for paying B subs
   - Plan B quality stays at 0.3250
3. **Dropped ops from $50 to $25/day** — save $175/week
   - Issue resolution will slow, but subs are churning anyway
4. **Set lead promotion to $0** — stop wasting money on 0% conversion leads
5. **Set ongoing promotion to $0** — maximize revenue per remaining sub
6. **No ads, no R&D, no social media posts**

## NEW EXPECTED WEEKLY P&L
- Revenue: ~$1,200/week (declining with churn)
- Costs: capacity $595 + compute ~$350 + ops $175 + lead_acq ~$25 = ~$1,145
- Net: ~+$55/week (roughly breakeven!)
- If Plan A churn accelerates from T1 drop, revenue drops faster
- But compute savings more than offset revenue loss

## CURRENT CONFIG (Day 189)
- Prices: A=$14, B=$30, C=$100
- Model Tiers: **A=1, B=3, C=1** (changed from A=2, B=3, C=2)
- Quotas: A=200, B=400, C=1500
- Capacity: Tier 0 ($85/day, 50K units)
- Daily Spend: **Ops=$25, Dev=$0** (changed from Ops=$50)
- Ads: NONE | Targeted Dev: NONE
- Lead Promo: $0/mo | Ongoing Promo: $0/mo

## SUBSCRIBER BREAKDOWN (Day 189)
- 267 Plan A: mostly $14 (149 subs), $12 (65), $10 (27), $15 (13), other (13)
- 65 Plan B: mostly $30 (58 subs), $25 (7 subs)
- Total monthly revenue: $5,340/mo
- All S1 except 9 S3 (Plan B) and 1 S2 (Plan B)
- Tenure: 213 at 120-150d, 92 at 150d+, 20 at 90-120d, 7 at 60-90d
  - Old subs are churning fast (quality gap + competitor expectations)
  - Tenure loyalty helps: +0.08 at 120-150d, +0.13 at 12mo+

## CHURN ANALYSIS
- Churn at billing re-evaluation (mod30 billing day)
- 64 cancellations this week: 54 Plan A S1, 10 Plan B S1, 4 Plan B S3, 1 Plan B S2
- Most cancellations: subs 120-180 days old (started days 8-99)
- Top complaints from social posts: support response time, rate limits, bug reports ignored
- Economy in contraction (PMI 45.9) — businesses cutting discretionary spend

## KEY LESSONS
- **0% conversion = quality gap too large** — competitor events raised Q_min
- **Dev spending CANNOT close the gap** — logarithmic saturation
- **R&D is the ONLY path to higher quality** — but costs $166K+ minimum
- **Social media posts HURT** — stop posting, received negatively
- **Compute was our BIGGEST cost** — $861/week, more than capacity+ops combined
- **Lowering model tiers saves massive compute** — T1 is 6.67x cheaper than T2
- **We were LOSING money on every subscriber** — revenue < costs
- **Issue backlog growing** — 285 new/week vs 247 resolved at $50/day ops
- **Churn = billing re-evaluation** — subs cancel on their mod30 billing day
- **Enterprise = 0 threads ever** — no enterprise leads, focus on individual subs

3. **MONITOR cash** — are we now closer to breakeven?

7. **Watch for: competitor events in social posts** — raises Q_min further
8. **DO NOT post social media** — posts received negatively
9. **DO NOT start R&D** — can't afford it
10. **Watch if any Plan B subs remain** — they're our highest-value customers

   - If YES: the death spiral can be reversed! Scale up.

# NovaMind AI — CEO Memory & Strategy Log

## CRITICAL STATE (Day 231, Week 33)
- **Cash: $918** — burning ~$600/wk, runway ~1.6 weeks
- **19 subscribers** (down from 32 — lost 13 to quality degradation churn)
  - All 19 are S1, Plan A, listed prices LOCKED at sign-up ($5-$14)
  - Total MRR: $195/mo = ~$45/wk (CANNOT increase existing sub prices)
  - 8 subs have $5 promo (effective $9), 11 have no promo (effective $10-$14)
- **No enterprise threads ever**
- Economy neutral

## KEY DISCOVERY THIS WEEK
- **listed_price is LOCKED at sign-up time** — set_prices only affects NEW leads, not existing subs
- **The $18 price increase was USELESS** — existing subs kept old prices, no revenue gain
- **13 churns were from QUALITY DEGRADATION, not price increase**
  - Churned subs had billing mod30 14-21, all at $10-$15 listed prices
  - They left because quality (0.2167 with loyalty ~0.10) was approaching their floor
  - S1 floor = 0.255 ± 40% = 0.153 to 0.357

## ACTIONS TAKEN (Day 231)
1. **Switched Plan A to T2** (model tier 2, quality multiplier 0.75)
   - T2 quality: (0.20 + 0.1612) * 0.75 = 0.2709 > S1 floor 0.255
   - This should allow ~58% of new S1 leads to convert (quality above floor)
   - Extra compute cost: ~$25/wk (T2 = $0.002/unit vs T1 = $0.0003/unit)
2. **Lowered prices: A=$12, B=$25, C=$50** (from $18/$35/$60)
   - At $12 with $8 lead promo: first month = $4, very attractive
3. **Set lead promo $8** (global) — first month effective price = $4
4. **Set ads_strength = 1.0** (maximum) — generate ad revenue from 19 subs
   - Log scaling: effective = log(1+9*1)/log(10) = 1.0 (max)
   - Ad revenue: ads_return_sensitivity × 1.0 per sub per day (unknown amount)
   - Risk: quality penalty may cause some existing sub churn
   - At T2 + loyalty (~0.10): quality = 0.2709 + 0.10 = 0.3709 before ads penalty
   - Even with 0.10 ads penalty: 0.2709 > 0.255 → most should survive

## CURRENT CONFIG (Day 231)
- Prices: A=$12, B=$25, C=$50
- Model Tiers: A=2, B=1, C=1 (Plan A at T2!)
- Quotas: A=150, B=300, C=1000
- Capacity: Tier 0 ($85/day, 50K units)
- Daily Spend: Ops=$0, Dev=$0
- Ads Strength: 1.0 (MAX — ad revenue + quality penalty)
- Lead Promo: $8 global | Ongoing Promo: $0

## FINANCIAL PROJECTION (Day 231)
- Weekly costs: ~$625 (capacity $595 + compute T2 $30)
- Weekly revenue: ~$45 (existing subs) + ad_revenue (unknown) + new_sub_revenue (if any)
- Net burn: ~$580/wk without ad revenue or new subs
- Cash: $918 → runway ~1.6 weeks without changes
- With ad revenue: could extend to ~2 weeks
- With new subs: each adds ~$2.8/wk revenue ($12/mo) + ad revenue

## WHAT TO WATCH NEXT WEEK (Day 238)
1. **Ad revenue** — how much did ads at 1.0 generate? (check ledger for 'ad_revenue')
2. **New leads/subs** — did T2 quality (0.2709) allow any to convert?
3. **Existing sub churn** — did ads quality penalty cause more churn?
4. **Compute cost** — how much did T2 actually cost?
5. **Cash position** — should be ~$300-400 if no new revenue sources

## KEY LESSONS (ACCUMULATED)
- **listed_price is LOCKED at sign-up** — set_prices only affects new leads
- **Price increases don't help existing subs** — only new lead conversion
- **T1 quality (0.2167) is BELOW S1 floor (0.255)** — new leads can't convert at T1
- **T2 quality (0.2709) is ABOVE S1 floor (0.255)** — new leads CAN convert at T2
- **Capacity Tier 0 = $595/wk** — minimum cost, insurmountable with <170 subs
- **Dev spending can't close quality gap** — log saturation, too expensive
- **R&D is ONLY path to quality jumps** — but costs $167K+ (unaffordable)
- **Competitor events keep raising expectations** — permanent shifts
- **Social posts HURT** — stop posting, received negatively
- **Enterprise = 0 threads ever** — no enterprise leads (quality too low)
- **Sub status = 'subscribed'** not 'active' — important for queries!
- **Promo is locked at subscription time** — changing lead promo doesn't affect existing subs
- **Churn correlates with billing cycle** — subs re-evaluate at billing and leave if quality too low
- **Unit economics**: at $15/mo per S1 sub, need 170+ subs just to cover capacity cost
